title: Marketplaces
description: Sell what you offer on big booking sites (marketplaces), and see what each one earns you.
keepOf: They keep {pct}%. On a {price} ticket you get {net}.

empty.title: No sites connected
empty.body: Connect one to sell where people already look for things to do. You agree their cut with them. We keep your prices and places the same on their site.

dialog.title: Connect a site
dialog.body: Once connected, we keep your prices and places the same on their site.
dialog.firstBody: You need a seller account with {name} and an agreed cut before this does anything. We can't sign up for you.
dialog.commissionHelp: The percentage you agreed with them.
dialog.example: On a {price} ticket they keep {commission} and you get {net}.
dialog.apiKeyHelp: From their website for sellers. We only keep the last four characters.
dialog.accountHelp: However they know you, e.g. a supplier ID or an email.

oneDescription: What {name} keeps, what you sell there, and what it has earned you.
toMatchTitle: To get what the counter gets
disconnectBody: Its {count, plural, one {# listing is} other {# listings are}} removed too. Past sales stay. You can connect again later.
sendDrafts: Send {count, plural, one {# draft} other {# drafts}} to them to check
submitted: {count, plural, one {# listing} other {# listings}} sent to them to check.
listingAdded: Added as a draft. Send it to them to check.

noListings.title: Nothing on this site yet
noListings.body: Add the bookings you want {name} to sell.

add.title: Add something to sell
add.body: Pick what you want this site to sell.

sendHintSubmitted: Already sent. Waiting for their answer.
sendHintRejected: They turned it down. The reason is under its name.
